profile.headline: Web Software Engineer II at St. Jude Children's Research Hospital - ALSAC
profile.summary:
Senior UI Developer at ALSAC/St. Jude in Memphis, TN. I have experience writing frontend and backend code, including working on the server and database layers. I always enjoy a new challenge, however I am not open to change positions at this time.

Please feel free to connect. If you email me, please include "LinkedIn" immediately in the subject line, or I will likely discard your email.

company.name: St. Jude Children's Research Hospital - ALSAC

positions.title: Sr. UI Developer I
positions.description:
In the role of a Senior UI Developer, I am the lead development resource on the Cultivation and Reengagement (CARE) team for frontend and/or user interface (UI) development. I take point on development tasks that center around creating and enhancing components and features on our application's Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Java-based codebase; this includes Java/JSP changes as well as JavaScript and Sass/CSS updates.

As a technical lead, I collaborate with other leads and our team's Product Owner to identify dependencies for tickets and otherwise prepare tickets for team refinement sessions. During and outside of specific tasks, I communicate and discuss with the CARE team's embedded UX Designer around current and upcoming design updates to our application, and help guide discussions around strategy, especially as it relates to technical constraints.

I continue the facilitation of the UI Group community of practice, and I am involved with efforts to develop and socialize a design system for enterprise-wide use, specifically lending my expertise on UI aspects. I aim to further my skills by seeking guidance from other development leads in my organizational division, and practice coaching strategies with development resources that join the CARE team.

positions.title: UI Developer
positions.description:
As a UI Developer, I am tasked with creating frontend capabilities for an in-development, unreleased application centered around personal information management. In this capacity, I collaborate with backend developers on the Account Management Service (AMS) team to create components and functionality in the Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) CMS, in 2-week sprints organized around Scrum/Agile processes.

The application in development had no user interface when I joined the team. This provided the opportunity to create a frontend workflow that allows for rapid and creative prototyping of features in a local environment, that also circumvented some unique challenges for creating an authenticated application in a CMS.

Through developing features, I also collaborate with a UX Designer embedded on our product team, and champion frontend best practices, accessibility, and empathetic experiences for our future users.

Other responsibilities include, but are not limited to, facilitating the UI Group community of practice for frontend development-focused peers, participating in department-wide design review meetings, joining other product teams (Donation and Web Experiences teams) when additional developers are needed, and championing Scrum/Agile standards and development best practices on the AMS team.

positions.title: Digital Developer
positions.description:
I am responsible for creating and maintaining websites, banner ad development, and email campaigns of various sizes and scope. I see projects from start to finish, taking into account art direction, QA feedback, and client revisions.

Daily tasks may include:

• Updating static site pages
• Integrating plugins or custom functionality into Wordpress sites
• Cutting up HTML emails
• Backing up and migrating SQL databases to production
• Developing landing pages from a designer's Photoshop proof file

positions.title: Jr. Developer
positions.description:
As a Junior Developer, I work with agency designers and developers to build and maintain websites using a variety of languages, content management systems, and vendor products. Alongside website development, I manage development and testing of  email campaigns, and development of HTML5 banner ads.

Technologies I use on the job include, but are not limited to:

• HTML5, CSS/Sass, PHP, and Javascript
• Git, SVN
• Grunt, Webpack, Jekyll
• Wordpress, Contentful 
• Sublime Text
• Terminal, bash
• Photoshop CC, Illustrator CC, Google Web Designer
• Salesforce Marketing Cloud

positions.title: Digital Development Intern
positions.description:
As an intern at Archer Malmo, I was tasked with developing my skills as a digital developer, learning about the different roles and the culture of the agency, and coordinating with my fellow interns on a group marketing project.

With my focus on frontend development, I worked on a variety of projects using different CMSs, languages, and build systems; I helped develop emails, managed content for Wordpress sites, and coded web pages for static sites. 

As part of the internship, myself and the 3 other interns were assigned a group project to provide marketing support for an agency client; we were asked to come up with a strategy to reach a targeted, yet unreached, market for the client. This included field research, competitor analysis, auditing of current client assets, and mentoring from industry professionals within the agency. The culmination of this project was a live presentation to the client's key decision makers, as well as Archer Malmo staff.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
I am working directly at ALSAC/St. Jude's iMedia team, which is a part of the iGroup of the Marketing division.

The team I work with does a lot of work with UX, UI, as well as design and front-end development.

I have participated in projects that included design, UX, content updating, and graphics editing. I worked mainly on P2P (Peer-to-Peer) subsites, ensuring that their design is up to specification and their functionality is optimal.

I used the following tools and languages at this position:

– HTML
– CSS
– Sublime Text 3
– Adobe Photoshop
– Adobe Illustrator

positions.title: Student Worker
positions.description:
• Edited and update the department website; via CMS client
• Managed schedules for Echo360 classroom recording suite
• Created forms for surveys and scheduling polls, collected an analyzed results; via Google Drive
• Edited, exported, and posted lecture videos for faculty members; via Camtasia video editing software and Canvas LMS.

company.name: Harding University – Center for Learning with Technology

volunteerExperiences.description: I work with staff to provide direction and guidance in relation to the ongoing programmatic needs and growth of GiVE 365, advocate on behalf of the general GiVE 365 membership, and participate in strategic discussions relating to the program.

projects.title: St Jude Telethon - Redesign
projects.description: I was given the task of restyling the Telethon site, including changing typography, button styles, replacing images, and optimizing the site for mobile and tablet users.

projects.title: Kestra Financial Website Development
projects.description:
Kestra Financial is a financial services company based out of Austin, TX. This site is meant to provide access to information regarding the company's 2 service wings- RIA and Private Wealth Services- as well as provide contact information to drive business acquisition.

Adam and I coordinated frontend development, while Heidi managed developer assets and client communications.

The site was created with the following technologies/principles:

- HTML
- CSS
- Javascript
- Foundation framework
- Gulp
- Responsive design/development
